caption: retro studios revives the kongs - barrel cannons, mine carts and the hardest banana hunt on the wii.
about: Donkey kong country returns (2010) is retro studios' revival: every level is a machine of barrel cannons, mine carts and rocket barrels tuned to nintendo's cruellest difficulty curve, with diddy's jetpack as the mercy rule. The two-player couch mode turns the difficulty into a comedy of grief, and the banana-hunt completionism gave the wii its best pure platformer.
No windows build exists, so the platform is wii - played through dolphin, rom sourced from romsfun.
